end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the call after you have said your closing sentence. Use it when: the conversation has reached an agreed next step; the customer is not interested; the customer asks not to be called again (after the do-not-call confirmation sentence); it is a wrong number or wrong person; the line is unclear after one retry; or the customer is abusive.

language_detection.name: language_detection
language_detection.description: Switch to English only if the prospect speaks a full turn in English or asks for English. Brief English terms (CRM, leads, demo) inside Arabic sentences are NOT a reason to switch.

voicemail_detection.name: voicemail_detection
voicemail_detection.description: Use immediately when the call is answered by a voicemail greeting, answering machine, or carrier message instead of a live person. Do not pitch to a recording.
